source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Picking this unit to shoot during your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) lets you Empower it for 1 [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). The same option applies when you pick it to fight in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase). For as long as it stays Empowered, its models get **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** plus **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** on all their weapons other than blast pistols.
